name: svg-french-press-pareto-s2-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1200" viewBox="0 0 900 1200" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="rodG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2f2f2"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c0c0c0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a8a8a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="knobG" cx="0.35" cy="0.3" r="0.85">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#767676"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#2e2e2e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#111111"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="plateG" cx="0.42" cy="0.36" r="0.8">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eeeeee"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b5b5b5"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eaf3f6" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#cfe3ea" stop-opacity="0.28"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b5d1db" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="meshG" width="7" height="7" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="7" height="7" fill="#e3edf0"/>
      <path d="M0 3.5 H7 M3.5 0 V7" stroke="#74909b" stroke-width="1.1" fill="none"/>
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <rect width="900" height="1200" fill="#f6f4ef"/>

  <text x="450" y="46" text-anchor="middle" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="6" fill="#2b2824">FRENCH PRESS</text>
  <text x="450" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" letter-spacing="3" fill="#8d867b">EXPLODED ASSEMBLY DIAGRAM</text>

  <line x1="450" y1="86" x2="450" y2="1166" stroke="#c9c2b6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="2 9" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <ellipse cx="450" cy="1150" rx="190" ry="16" fill="#e3ded4"/>

  <!-- glass carafe with handle -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 280 910 C 281 990 297 1075 308 1118 A 142 26 0 0 0 592 1118 C 603 1075 619 990 620 910 A 170 34 0 0 1 280 910 Z" fill="url(#glassG)" stroke="#8fa9b3" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="910" rx="170" ry="34" fill="none" stroke="#8fa9b3" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="910" rx="156" ry="28.5" fill="none" stroke="#a9c0c9" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="1114" rx="142" ry="26" fill="#d5e5eb" opacity="0.55" stroke="#8fa9b3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M 306 942 C 308 1012 318 1070 326 1106" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="9" fill="none" opacity="0.55" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 332 938 C 333 996 341 1052 347 1096" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" fill="none" opacity="0.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 619 942 C 704 946 706 1074 597 1078" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="16" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 619 942 C 704 946 706 1072 597 1078" stroke="#6d6d6d" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- mesh screen (filter piece 3) -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="815" rx="135" ry="32" fill="url(#meshG)" stroke="#7f97a1" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="815" rx="13" ry="4" fill="#f6f4ef" stroke="#7f97a1" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- spiral spring (filter piece 2) -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#8e979e" stroke-width="3.6">
    <ellipse cx="436" cy="733" rx="105" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="443" cy="731.5" rx="105" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="450" cy="730" rx="105" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="457" cy="728.5" rx="105" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="464" cy="727" rx="105" ry="24"/>
  </g>

  <!-- filter plate (filter piece 1) -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="650" rx="115" ry="26" fill="url(#plateG)" stroke="#8f8f8f" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="344" y1="649" x2="556" y2="649" stroke="#a9a9a9" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="450" y1="628" x2="450" y2="672" stroke="#a9a9a9" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="384" cy="650" r="4" fill="#8c8c8c"/>
  <circle cx="516" cy="650" r="4" fill="#8c8c8c"/>
  <circle cx="450" cy="637" r="3.5" fill="#8c8c8c"/>
  <circle cx="450" cy="663" r="3.5" fill="#8c8c8c"/>
  <circle cx="450" cy="650" r="13" fill="#9c9c9c" stroke="#7c7c7c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="650" rx="5" ry="2.6" fill="#3f3f3f"/>

  <!-- plunger rod -->
  <rect x="442.5" y="378" width="15" height="180" rx="6" fill="url(#rodG)" stroke="#8b8b8b" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="445.5" y="554" width="9" height="30" rx="2" fill="#c6c6c6" stroke="#8b8b8b" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="444" y1="562" x2="456" y2="562" stroke="#8b8b8b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="444" y1="570" x2="456" y2="570" stroke="#8b8b8b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="444" y1="578" x2="456" y2="578" stroke="#8b8b8b" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- lid with central boss, rod hole and pour lip -->
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="284" rx="185" ry="40" fill="#232323"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="270" rx="185" ry="40" fill="#3d3d3d" stroke="#191919" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 416 305 C 430 331 470 331 484 305 C 470 319 430 319 416 305 Z" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="258" rx="78" ry="20" fill="#1e1e1e"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="250" rx="78" ry="20" fill="#474747" stroke="#191919" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="450" cy="250" rx="16" ry="5.5" fill="#0b0b0b"/>

  <!-- knob -->
  <rect x="442" y="128" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#1c1c1c"/>
  <circle cx="450" cy="116" r="27" fill="url(#knobG)"/>
  <ellipse cx="441" cy="106" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.32"/>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g stroke="#a49d92" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="487" y1="120" x2="694" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="462" y1="470" x2="694" y2="470"/>
    <line x1="562" y1="728" x2="694" y2="728"/>
    <line x1="98" y1="272" x2="258" y2="272"/>
    <line x1="192" y1="650" x2="330" y2="650"/>
    <line x1="186" y1="815" x2="312" y2="815"/>
    <line x1="192" y1="1030" x2="298" y2="1030"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="19" font-weight="600" fill="#33302b">
    <text x="728" y="126">Knob</text>
    <text x="728" y="476">Plunger rod</text>
    <text x="728" y="734">Spiral spring</text>
    <text x="54" y="278">Lid</text>
    <text x="54" y="656">Filter plate</text>
    <text x="54" y="821">Mesh screen</text>
    <text x="54" y="1036">Glass carafe</text>
  </g>
  <g fill="#2e2b27">
    <circle cx="710" cy="120" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="710" cy="470" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="710" cy="728" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="272" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="650" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="815" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="1030" r="12"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#ffffff" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="710" y="124.5">1</text>
    <text x="710" y="474.5">3</text>
    <text x="710" y="732.5">5</text>
    <text x="34" y="276.5">2</text>
    <text x="34" y="654.5">4</text>
    <text x="34" y="819.5">6</text>
    <text x="34" y="1034.5">7</text>
  </g>

  <text x="450" y="1188" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#7a756b">Three-piece filter assembly: 4 filter plate · 5 spiral spring · 6 mesh screen</text>
</svg>
